title: View the clinical history
summary: Timeline with the patient's clinical sessions, odontograms and appointments; filter and print.

steps.title: Menu → Patients
steps.details: Patient list; tapping one opens their record on the right.

steps.title: Open their record
steps.details: Tap the patient in the list. The guide continues once their record is open.

steps.title: Events
steps.details: Clinical sessions, odontograms and appointments, from newest to oldest. Tap an event to see its details.

steps.title: Filter
steps.details: By event type (clinical, odontogram, appointment) and by doctor.

steps.title: Print history
steps.details: Prints the medical history and the clinical sessions.

steps.title: New session
steps.details: Adds a clinical or odontogram session.
